run_FluxDenoiseStep: run the FluxDenoiseStep block to iteratively denoise latents for text2image and img2img tasks
run_FluxKontextDenoiseStep: run the FluxKontextDenoiseStep block to iteratively denoise latents for Flux Kontext text2image and img2img tasks
run_FluxLoopDenoiser: run the FluxLoopDenoiser block to predict noise from the transformer using latents, prompt embeds, and RoPE IDs
run_FluxKontextLoopDenoiser: run the FluxKontextLoopDenoiser block to predict noise by concatenating image latents for Flux Kontext denoising
run_FluxLoopAfterDenoiser: run the FluxLoopAfterDenoiser block to update latents using the scheduler step with predicted noise
